title: Son of Spergy
summary: This album represents a repenting and reflecting attitude that I absolutely love from him. Its angelic choruses and gospel are extremely prevalent and beautiful throughout. Plus, his NPR Tiny Desk was insane. Son of Spergy perfectly epitomizes why he's my GOAT.

title: Charm
summary: Clairo is indeed performative to listen to, and I was begged by my little sister to listen. I did, and it was awesome. It came at a time when I was playing more jazz than ever while also living in LA, and I think I'll be permanently addicted to drum brushes and buttery neck pickup progressions from now on. Excited to hear more of her like this in the future.

title: Malcolm Todd
summary: I've been listening since he had 8,000 monthly listeners on Spotify, and at the time of writing he's at 13,484,092 (look at my boy go). His production skyrocketed in quality from the beginning EP days, and I appreciate the professional touch. This album specifically is more of the same Malcolm Todd that I've always loved, and I love (no pun intended) that he's now breaking into the mainstream.

title: Grace
summary: An album for those who yearn, like me. It's almost like you can visibly see him sing through his voice. Extremely good taste and structure, extremely pleased overall.
